testcase.name: PAGE01: all 1,258 owned records are reachable with stable pages and no other requester data
PAGE02: search finds an old request beyond the former 1,000-row window and treats wildcards literally
PAGE03: status, category and search are combined before paging, with complete matching totals
PAGE04: complete work totals exclude wrong-category and sensitive records regardless of ownership
PAGE05: anonymous, requester and admin cannot invoke a work list or aggregate
PAGE06: empty sets, out-of-range pages, invalid paging and sort have bounded behaviour
PAGE07: API boundary forwards typed paging options and reports database failures safely
PAGE08: migration preserves existing rows, access policies and audit history
